01 / About

I design, build, and ship production software — not just notebooks.

I build practical software at the intersection of AI/ML, backend engineering, and full-stack development — with six deployed products carrying live URLs and public code, not just local demos.

My work spans the full lifecycle: data modeling, API design, authentication, ML pipelines, and deployment. Recent builds include an AI-powered pilgrimage-planning platform pairing a Claude-driven itinerary planner with Supabase-backed auth, visitor reviews, and admin moderation; a fraud-detection service scoring transactions at 0.9997 AUC on 6.3M PaySim records; a multi-agent clinical decision-support platform combining triage and drug-interaction checks; and a full-stack healthcare appointment manager with LLM-generated pre- and post-visit summaries, email notifications, and Google Calendar sync. Alongside product work, I keep a deliberate practice of fundamentals — DSA in Java, operating systems, databases, and system design — reflected in a top-10% global finish at TCS CodeVita Season 13.

Temple Heritage

MediAgent AI
Multi-agent clinical decision-support platform: AI triage, emergency detection, and automatic department routing via LangChain agents on Groq Llama. Live OpenFDA drug-interaction checks, lab-report OCR via pdfplumber + Tesseract, AI-generated PDF consult reports, and a Plotly analytics dashboard over an SQLAlchemy-backed store.

03
FraudShield AI
XGBoost fraud detection model trained on 6.3M PaySim transactions, hitting a 0.9997 AUC, with class imbalance handled via imbalanced-learn. Deployed as a live FastAPI + Uvicorn API with Pydantic-validated schemas, plus a separate frontend for real-time inference.
XGBoostPythonPydanticRailwayVercel
GitHub → Live Demo →
04
EduGrade-AI
Virtual-classroom platform automating grading — join-code classes, role-based access, Google Document AI OCR, and two-layer plagiarism detection (sequence/cosine/trigram similarity) escalating to handwriting comparison. Gemini-based grading with in-place PDF annotation, on a normalized SQLAlchemy schema with per-row caching of AI artifacts.
Document AIGeminiSQLAlchemyRender
GitHub → Live Demo →
05
Document Q&A — RAG Chatbot
Retrieval-augmented chat over your own PDFs, built with LangChain, Gemini embeddings, and ChromaDB. Every answer cites its source document, page, and similarity score — strictly grounded, so it says "not in the docs" instead of guessing. Rate-limit-aware batched ingestion keeps it inside free-tier API quotas.
LangChainGeminiChromaDBRender
GitHub → Live Demo →
06
Autonomous Lunar Landing — PPO
Deep RL agent that lands a spacecraft in Gymnasium's LunarLander-v3 using PPO (Stable-Baselines3). A custom callback tracks landing success rate — safe, crash, or timeout — not just mean reward, with TensorBoard curves and 50k-step checkpointing. A deterministic evaluation harness reports the full outcome breakdown across N episodes.
Stable-Baselines3GymnasiumPyTorchTensorBoard
GitHub →
07
Healthcare Appointment & Follow-up Manager
Full-stack clinic platform with separate patient, doctor, and admin portals. Patients describe symptoms pre-visit and an LLM drafts an urgency-flagged summary for the doctor; post-visit notes are turned into a patient-friendly summary and medication schedule. Email confirmations, Google Calendar sync, and automated medication reminders round it out.
